NOTE: this pattern was NOT observed when navigating via in-app clicks within Dispatch/Factoring/Accounting/Safety earlier in this walk -- those consistently returned to the correct immediate prior page -- so the defect appears specific to the direct-URL-entry case, which is exactly how a user arrives via a bookmark, a shared link, or typing a URL.
